counting: 98 backend identities plus 20 browser workflows. Clean-copy backend tests repeat the same cases and are not added again. Setup/syntax/assets are additional gates, not inflated test totals.

checks.name: explicit sign-in without persisted credentials
search and bounded list pagination
flag creation renders hostile text literally
stale writes preserve changed fields and refresh unedited fields
protected changes require acknowledgment of the current draft
environment create edit and reference-safe delete
project create edit and delete
segment create and edit typed constraints
invalid JSON reports the field and preserves the draft
strategy create edit and scoped segment reference
variant defaults typed JSON payload update and delete
dependency creation immutable review and removal
one-time token display dismissal and revocation
lost creation response blocks automatic retry and retains draft

limits: Loopback local JSON store; no distributed persistence or power-loss guarantee.
No durable mutation receipts, metrics deduplication/automatic pruning, or account recovery.
Basic persisted shape/identity validation; no complete relational migration validation or duplicate-JSON-key rejection.
Chromium desktop/mobile checks, not all-browser or assistive-technology certification.
